newsitem.title: USA: Tridex to sell Cash Bases unit.
newsitem.headline: Tridex to sell Cash Bases unit.

text.p: Tridex Corp said Thursday it entered into a letter of intent to sell its wholly owned subsidiary Cash Bases GB Ltd for up to $6.2 million.
Tridex said it intends to sell the unit to a group comprised of the present executive directors of Cash Bases and Lloyds Development Capital Ltd.

Tridex said the sale is for up to $6.2. million, consisting of $5.2 million in cash, a $250,000 unsecured promissory note bearing interest at the rate of 10 percent per annum payable in full on April 30, 2000, an earn out of up to $750,000 depending upon Cash Bases' earnings before interest and taxes for the fiscal years ending December 31, 1998 and December 31, 1999, and a 10 percent equity stake in the newly organized buyer.
The proposed transaction is subject to approval by the board of directors of Lloyds Development Capital and to the execution of a definitive agreement.
Tridex chairman and chief executive officer Seth Lukash said that the sale is expected to close by the middle of May.

"The senior management of Cash Bases made an unsolicited proposal to Tridex which we think is in the best interests of Tridex and its shareholders to accept," Lukash said. "Tridex's board of directors already has approved the proposed transaction.
